Senior Full-Stack Engineer

Acme Analytics | Remote (EU/US timezones) | Full-time

About the role
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join the Pulse ingestion squad. You will design, build and operate the services that collect product telemetry from over a thousand engineering teams, and the React front end their teams live in every day.

What you will do
- Build and operate high-throughput TypeScript services on Node.js (Kafka ingestion, funnel APIs)
- Ship polished React front ends for funnel exploration and alerting
- Model and evolve PostgreSQL schemas handling billions of events
- Own services end to end: commit, deploy, on-call (one week in eight)
- Mentor mid-level engineers through design reviews and pairing

What we require (must have)
- 5+ years of professional experience building production web applications
- Strong TypeScript and modern React experience
- Solid Node.js backend experience: streaming, queues, REST APIs
- Hands-on PostgreSQL experience: schema design, query tuning, migrations
- Experience deploying and operating services on AWS
- You write tests as a matter of course and have worked with CI/CD pipelines
- Clear written communication in an async, remote-first culture

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka or other streaming systems
- Kubernetes in production
- GraphQL API design
- Experience mentoring junior engineers formally

Compensation
Salary band for this role is published in our handbook. We pay for take-home time if you ask.

Backend Engineer (Mid-Level)

Example Systems builds billing infrastructure for SaaS companies. We need a backend engineer to work on our metering and invoicing APIs.

Responsibilities
- Develop Go services handling usage metering and invoice generation
- Extend our public REST API and keep the docs honest
- Improve reliability of nightly reconciliation jobs

Requirements
- 3+ years backend experience
- Strong Go or comparable experience in a typed language
- Solid SQL skills (we use PostgreSQL)
- Comfortable with Docker-based deploys
- Experience with billing, payments or fintech systems

Bonus points
- Stripe or other payment provider integrations
- Terraform
- Experience with event-driven architectures

We are hiring a developer.
Apply now.

QA Automation Engineer

Northwind Tools | Hybrid, Berlin

We need someone to own automated testing of our web platform.

Required:
- 3+ years writing automated end-to-end tests
- Strong Playwright or Cypress experience
- TypeScript
- CI pipeline experience (GitHub Actions)
- Ability to work closely with product teams on acceptance criteria

Preferred:
- API test automation experience
- Performance testing basics

Senior Backend Engineer, Package Registry

GitLab | Remote

The Package stage builds the registries (npm, Maven, Docker, Conan and more) that ship code through GitLab. As a senior backend engineer you will make them faster, more reliable and pleasant to use at very large scale.

What you'll do
- Own significant parts of the Package registry architecture in Ruby on Rails and Go
- Improve storage tiering and deduplication across object stores
- Drive performance work on metadata database hot paths
- Partner with SREs on scalability, observability and on-call quality
- Mentor engineers across the stage through merge request reviews

Requirements
- 5+ years professional backend engineering experience
- Deep experience with Ruby on Rails, or deep experience in another major backend stack plus willingness to master Rails
- Strong relational database skills (PostgreSQL): query plans, indexes, migrations at scale
- Distributed systems experience: queues, caching, idempotency, retries
- Experience operating services in production including on-call rotations
- Excellent written communication for our handbook-first, async culture

Nice to have
- Go in production
- Object storage systems (S3, GCS) at scale
- Experience with container registries or package ecosystems
- Contribution history in open source
